outcome: postpartum complications (postpartum hemorrhage, perineal tears, cervical tears)
cohort: 263 women who had uncomplicated vaginal births at three health facilities in Mpigi and Butambala districts, Uganda.
finding: The prevalence of postpartum complications was 14.1%, and women who did not undergo a postpartum check in the first three hours, were discharged after 24 hours, or were transferred to the postpartum ward after two hours, were more likely to develop these complications.
cross-section timing: Immediate postpartum period (within the first few hours up to 24 hours after birth), from November 2020 to January 2021.
